Key facts, with sources:

- Woodside listed six Capella homes from $599,950 to $679,950 on the page retrieved 2026-10-12. Plans are single-story, 1,970 to 2,295 square feet. https://www.woodsidehomes.com/findmyhome/nevada/las-vegas/capella-at-sunstone
- Sunstone’s site names Lennar, Shea Homes, Woodside Homes, and Richmond American Homes, about 3,650 homes, parks, trails, and an age-qualified neighborhood. Retrieved 2026-10-12. https://sunstonelv.com/
- Shea labels Trilogy Sunstone 55+ and priced it from $399,990 on 2026-10-12. https://www.sheahomes.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas-area/las-vegas/trilogy-sunstone
- Lennar listed Axel townhomes from $383,990 to $462,565 and Alia Estates from $862,990 on 2026-10-12, with an approximate monthly HOA of $210 for Axel. https://www.lennar.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas/las-vegas/sunstone/axel
- Off-peak drive times measured 2026-09-30: Strip at Bellagio about 29 minutes, Harry Reid International Airport about 49 minutes. https://www.nevadarealestategroup.com/north-las-vegas/sunstone
- Homes.com Sunstone local guide, retrieved 2026-10-13, lists ZIPs 89143 and 89166, Trilogy as 55+, builders from Lennar to Woodside, Sun Trails Park, Sun Mountain Park, the Nature Paseo, a mountain bike trail around the Moccasin Walking Trail, and Alyn Beck Memorial Park. The page does not date its $561,604 average value, $269 per square foot, or 105-home count. It says “over 3,000” planned homes; sunstonelv.com says about 3,650. Its airport drive time (about 30 minutes) disagrees with the September 30, 2026 measurement of about 49 minutes. https://www.homes.com/local-guide/las-vegas-nv/sunstone-neighborhood/

Not established in sources checked 2026-10-12: a 90-day Sunstone median sale price, closed-sale list-to-sale ratios, a Capella HOA dollar amount, solar-lease terms, and a confirmed school assignment for a specific address.

Builder prices on this site are asking prices, not closed sales and not an MLS feed. Retired paths /financing, /buyers-guide, and /service-areas redirect to current pages.
